plainLanguage: Section 59 criminalises administering, consenting to, or voluntarily taking an oath or oath-like engagement purporting to bind a person to commit an offence punishable with death.
meaning: Ufafanuzi wa section 59 lazima ufuate complete statutory text, qualifications na procedural requirements zake; label ya offence pekee haitoshi.
keyPoints: Covers administering and presence with consent.
Also covers taking the oath where the person was not compelled.
The oath must purport to bind commission of an offence punishable with death.

legalTerms.meaning: Maana na scope yake huamuliwa na exact wording ya statutory provision na authoritative interpretation.

history.summary: Section 59 is recorded in The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text was audited before this explanation was added.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory element and qualification should be analysed separately.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Where the section states a procedural safeguard or consent requirement, it should be treated as part of the legal analysis.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na procedure vinatimiza exact requirements zote za section 59?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
